body: Only 2bcfd5c landed. Star Castle enemies has 4 commits (cannon turns toward the ship and next-ship height follow the frame clock, both verified, plus a review fix and a checklist regen). The POKEY emulator is calibrated against astdelux; its review needs attention and is being fixed. Rule: xtask land lets an intermediate commit fail verify only on fixture staleness, only when the tip is the regen commit and passes the full gate; tests, clippy and parity still run on every commit.
summary: VectorCraft hits the same problem; the 4 steps go in #42, with a landing exception for stale fixtures
